definitions.explanation: A social gathering where a group of men and a group of women meet, typically at a restaurant or bar, with the aim of finding romantic partners. Usually organized by one person from each side who knows each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧{合|ごう}コン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a group date this week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合|ごう}コン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}われた→誘う：01947_sasou⟧。
examples.english: A friend invited me to a group blind date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{合|ごう}コン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}していた→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a college student, I often went to group dates.

notes:
Short for ⟦{合同|ごうどう}→合同：04185_goudou⟧コンパ (joint drinking party). コンパ itself comes from English "company" or German "Kompanie."

Typically involves equal numbers of men and women (often 3-on-3 or 4-on-4) meeting at a restaurant or izakaya. Very common among university students and young working adults in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合|ごう}コン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ — to organize a group date
- {合|ごう}コン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ — to attend a group date
- {合|ごう}コン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧ — to invite someone to a group date
- {合|ごう}コン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ — the organizer of a group date
